answer: A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 325 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. The dawn graph is validated at intake and the meadow frontier is published, and thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and opal anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A 142 account operation therefore ties up 24 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
